question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CAST((CURRENT_DATE - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST((CURRENT_DATE - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST((CURRENT_DATE - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST((CURRENT_DATE - CAST(birth_date AS DATE)) / 365 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'Others'
  END as age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category
